openFindings.title: Manifest paths can redirect sync writes outside package roots
Plugin build can delete an external skills directory through a symlinked parent
Manifest paths can redirect sync writes outside package roots
openFindings.description: Before any read or write, reject absolute paths and parent traversal, resolve local_path and upstream_path beneath their designated roots, and resolve every include entry beneath both package roots. Add scratch-world tests proving pull and push refuse escapes without touching the outside target.

Plugin build does not reject symlinked hub source files
openFindings.description: Reject symlinks for every HUB_FILES source before adding it to the map, and add a scratch self-test that plants a symlink at one root hub file and expects refusal.
